item.title: Yale to waive all costs for new undergraduates from families earning less than $100,000
item.description: Yale University is eliminating tuition and other costs for all new undergraduates from families earning less than $100,000 a year, joining a growing number of elite campuses that are slashing costs for middle- and lower-income families.

item.title: Emergency shelters open overnight during freezing cold temps
item.description: The Pinpoint Weather 12 team says bitter cold temperatures are here to stay, with wind chills dipping as low as -20 degrees Fahrenheit late Thursday night and Friday morning. They warn that any exposed skin could be prone to frostbite in as little as 30 minutes.

item.description: In Providence, hundreds gathered at the State House Friday afternoon to protest the federal government's immigration crackdown.

item.title: Smiley: DPW workers 'have not stopped' hauling snow from the city
item.description: Providence Mayor Brett Smiley asked for patience Friday as the city works tirelessly to remove the dense mounds of snow left behind by Sunday's massive winter storm.
